name: Abyss
intro: The Abyss pathway embodies desire, corruption, brutality and demonic power. Its abilities are aggressive and often become stronger through debuffs and suffering.

meter.name: Desire
meter.gain: A marked enemy spending SP from Sequence 5

ability.name: Brutal Strike
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Brutal Strike — Deals 140% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Physical damage (22% base DEF bypass); +15% DEF bypass on this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Desire Ignition
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Desire Ignition — Deals 120% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Fire damage (22% base DEF bypass); Increases target skill SP costs by 30% for 1 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 20 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Devil's Skin
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Devil's Skin — +15% DEF; +15% Physical direct-damage resistance, +15% Fire direct-damage resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Magma Arrow
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Magma Arrow — Deals 160% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Magma damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Corrupted Flesh
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Corrupted Flesh — Immediately restores 15% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; From Sequence 5, mark one enemy for 5 turns. Its actual paid SP grows Desire; At 100 charge, detonate 50% INT plus its paid SP as Fire damage. Shared accuracy, Dodge and forced-miss rules apply.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Desire Ignition Burst
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Desire Ignition Burst — Deals 180% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Magma damage (22% base DEF bypass); Increases target skill SP costs by 50% for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Devil Mutation
ability.label: Active Stance
ability.description: Devil Mutation — +25% ATK for 2 turns; +20% DEF for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 65 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Foul Corruption
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Foul Corruption — Deals 270% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Magma damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Abyssal Emperor
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Abyssal Emperor — Deals 330% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Magma damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Monarch of Magma
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Monarch of Magma — Deals 420% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 125 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
